docs.title: GoGoogle
docs.text: Go libraries for Google APIs - higher-level utilities built on the official Google API Go Client.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
GoGoogle provides simplified, production-ready interfaces for common Google API operations:

Package Description Gmail Send emails, manage messages, mail merge Docs Extract content from Google Docs Sheets Read/write spreadsheet data with typed structs Slides Create presentations, add content Search Console Read Search Console properties, search performance, sitemaps and URL inspection Maps Generate static map images Speech Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech Forms OAuth scope helpers for Forms API YouTube URL utilities (short URLs) CLI Command-line tools for Google APIs

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Simplified APIs - Higher-level functions for common operations
  • Type Safety - Go structs for API data
  • Batch Operations - Efficient bulk processing
  • Mail Merge - Template-based email campaigns with Sheets integration
  • OAuth2 Support - Built-in authentication helpers

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text: go get github.com/grokify/gogoogle

docs.title: Send an Email
docs.text:
import (
    "context"
    "github.com/grokify/gogoogle/gmailutil/v1"
)

// Create Gmail service (after OAuth setup)
service, _ := gmailutil.NewGmailService(ctx, httpClient)

// Send a simple email
service.SendSimple(ctx, "me", gmailutil.SendSimpleOpts{
    To:       "recipient@example.com",
    Subject:  "Hello from GoGoogle",
    BodyText: "This is a test email.",
    BodyHTML: "<p>This is a <b>test</b> email.</p>",
})

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
GoGoogle is a set of independent packages over the official Google API Go Client. Each package is named <name>util and carries its API version in the import path, for example gmailutil/v1 or searchconsoleutil/v1.

  • Each package takes an authorized *http.Client or builds one from credentials, so the caller chooses how people or services sign in.
  • Packages wrap the generated client in types and functions for common tasks and return errors that carry the underlying Google error.
  • Packages do not depend on each other.

Package guides are under Guides.

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text:
GoGoogle uses OAuth2 for authentication. You'll need:

  1. A Google Cloud project with APIs enabled
  2. OAuth2 credentials (client_secret.json)
  3. User authorization (generates token.json)

docs.title: Enable Google APIs
docs.text:
1. Go to Google Cloud Console
  2. Create or select a project
  3. Enable the APIs you need:
  4. Gmail API
  5. Google Sheets API
  6. Google Slides API
  7. etc.

docs.title: Create OAuth Credentials
docs.text:
1. Go to APIs & Services > Credentials
  2. Click Create Credentials > OAuth client ID
  3. Select Desktop app as application type
  4. Download the JSON file as client_secret.json

docs.title: Authorize Your Application
docs.text:
Use goauth for OAuth2 flow:

import (
    "context"
    "github.com/grokify/goauth/google"
)

client, err := google.NewClientOAuthCLITokenStore(google.ClientOAuthCLITokenStoreConfig{
    Context:   ctx,
    AppConfig: clientSecretJSON,  // Contents of client_secret.json
    Scopes:    []string{
        "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send",
        "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.readonly",
    },
    TokenFile: "token.json",      // Will be created after authorization
    State:     "my-app",
})
if err != nil {
    log.Fatal(err)
}

On first run, this opens a browser for user authorization. The token is saved to token.json for subsequent runs.

docs.title: CLI Tools

docs.title: Installation

docs.title: Commands
docs.text: Command Description gmail merge Send templated emails via mail merge gmail send-markdown Send email with markdown body slides content Extract content from presentations

docs.title: Gmail: Mail Merge
docs.text:
Send templated emails using Google Sheets data:

gogoogle gmail merge \
    --credentials client_secret.json \
    --token token.json \
    --sheet-id "1abc123..." \
    --subject-template templates/subject.mustache \
    --html-template templates/body.html.mustache \
    --text-template templates/body.txt.mustache

docs.title: Options
docs.text: Flag Description --credentials OAuth credentials file --token Token file path --sheet-id Google Sheets ID --sheet-name Sheet name (default: first sheet) --subject-template Subject template file --html-template HTML body template file --text-template Plain text template file --inline Inline image (format: cid:path) --attachment File attachment path --from From address (default: "me")

docs.title: Example with Inline Images
docs.text:
gogoogle gmail merge \
    --sheet-id "1abc123..." \
    --subject-template "Newsletter - {{date}}" \
    --html-template templates/newsletter.html.mustache \
    --inline "logo:images/logo.png" \
    --inline "banner:images/banner.jpg" \
    --attachment "documents/terms.pdf"

docs.text:

gogoogle gmail send-markdown \
    --credentials client_secret.json \
    --token token.json \
    --to recipient@example.com \
    --subject "Meeting Notes" \
    --body @notes.md

docs.title: Google Docs Utilities
docs.text: The docsutil/v1 package provides utilities for working with the Google Docs API.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: import docsutil "github.com/grokify/gogoogle/docsutil/v1"

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Client wrapper - Simplified Google Docs API client
  • Content extraction - Extract structured content (headings, paragraphs, images, tables)
  • Text extraction - Get plain text or paragraph-by-paragraph text
  • URL parsing - Extract document IDs from Google Docs URLs

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "log"
    "net/http"

    docsutil "github.com/grokify/gogoogle/docsutil/v1"
)

func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()

    // Create client with authenticated HTTP client
    client, err := docsutil.NewClient(ctx, httpClient)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    // Get document by ID or URL
    docID := docsutil.ParseDocumentID("https://docs.google.com/document/d/DOC_ID/edit")

    // Extract all content
    content, err := client.ExtractContent(ctx, docID, docsutil.ExtractOptions{
        IncludeImages: true,
        IncludeTables: true,
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    fmt.Printf("Title: %s\n", content.Title)
    for _, section := range content.Sections {
        fmt.Printf("[%s] %s\n", section.Type, section.Text)
    }
}

docs.title: ExtractContent
docs.text:
Returns structured content including headings, paragraphs, images, and tables.

content, err := client.ExtractContent(ctx, docID, docsutil.ExtractOptions{
    IncludeImages:  true,
    IncludeTables:  true,
    IncludeHeaders: true,
    IncludeFooters: true,
})

Returns:

  • Title - Document title
  • Sections - Array of content sections with type, level, and text
  • Images - Array of image info (if requested)
  • Tables - Array of table data (if requested)
  • Headers - Array of header text (if requested)
  • Footers - Array of footer text (if requested)

docs.title: ExtractText
docs.text:
Returns all document text as a single string.

text, err := client.ExtractText(ctx, docID)

docs.title: ExtractParagraphs
docs.text:
Returns text organized by paragraphs.

paragraphs, err := client.ExtractParagraphs(ctx, docID)
for _, p := range paragraphs {
    fmt.Println(p)
}

docs.title: URL Parsing
docs.text:
Parse document IDs from various Google Docs URL formats:

// Standard edit URL
id := docsutil.ParseDocumentID("https://docs.google.com/document/d/DOC_ID/edit")

// URL with query parameters
id := docsutil.ParseDocumentID("https://docs.google.com/document/d/DOC_ID/edit?tab=t.0")

// URL with anchors
id := docsutil.ParseDocumentID("https://docs.google.com/document/d/DOC_ID/edit#heading=h.xyz")

// Just the ID
id := docsutil.ParseDocumentID("DOC_ID")

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text:
The client requires an authenticated *http.Client. Use goauth for OAuth2 setup:

import "github.com/grokify/goauth/google"

// Service account
httpClient, err := google.NewClientSvcAccountFromFile(ctx, "credentials.json",
    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/documents.readonly",
)

// OAuth2 user credentials
httpClient, err := google.NewClientFromTokenFile(ctx, "token.json")

docs.title: Required Scopes
docs.text:
• https://www.googleapis.com/auth/documents.readonly - Read-only access
  • https://www.googleapis.com/auth/documents - Full access

docs.title: Gmail
docs.text: The gmailutil/v1 package provides utilities for Gmail API operations.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Send emails - Simple and advanced message composition
  • Read messages - List, filter, and retrieve emails
  • Batch operations - Delete multiple messages efficiently
  • Mail merge - Send templated emails using Google Sheets data
  • Label management - List and manage Gmail labels

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
import (
    "context"
    "net/http"
    "github.com/grokify/gogoogle/gmailutil/v1"
)

// Create Gmail service
func getGmailService(ctx context.Context, httpClient *http.Client) (*gmailutil.GmailService, error) {
    return gmailutil.NewGmailService(ctx, httpClient)
}

docs.title: SendSimple (Recommended)
docs.text:
The simplest way to send emails:

_, err := service.SendSimple(ctx, "me", gmailutil.SendSimpleOpts{
    To:       "recipient@example.com",
    Subject:  "Hello",
    BodyText: "Plain text body",
    BodyHTML: "<p>HTML body</p>",  // Optional
    ReplyTo:  "replies@example.com", // Optional
})

docs.title: Send with MessageWriter
docs.text:
For more control over email composition:

import "github.com/grokify/mogo/net/mailutil"

msg := mailutil.MessageWriter{
    To:      mailutil.Addresses{{Address: "recipient@example.com"}},
    Subject: "Hello",
    // ... additional fields
}

_, err := service.Send(ctx, "me", msg)

docs.title: Mail Merge
docs.text: Send templated emails to multiple recipients using Google Sheets as the data source.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Mail merge allows you to:

  • Define email templates with Mustache placeholders
  • Pull recipient data from Google Sheets
  • Send personalized emails at scale
  • Include inline images and attachments

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
import "github.com/grokify/gogoogle/gmailutil/v1/mailmerge"

mm := mailmerge.MailMerge{
    GmailService: gmailService,
    SheetsService: sheetsService,
    SpreadsheetID: "your-spreadsheet-id",
    SubjectTemplate: "Hello {{name}}!",
    BodyHTMLTemplate: "<p>Dear {{name}}, your order #{{order_id}} is ready.</p>",
    BodyTextTemplate: "Dear {{name}}, your order #{{order_id}} is ready.",
}

err := mm.Execute(ctx)

docs.title: Google Sheets Format
docs.text:
Your spreadsheet must have these columns:

Column Required Description TO Yes Recipient email address CC No CC recipients BCC No BCC recipients * No Any other columns become template variables

    --html-template "templates/body.html.mustache" \

    GmailService:         gmailService,

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
1. Test first - Send to yourself before bulk sending
  2. Include unsubscribe - Required for marketing emails
  3. Plain text fallback - Always include text version
  4. Rate limiting - Gmail has daily sending limits
  5. Validate data - Check sheet for missing/invalid emails

docs.title: Query Syntax
docs.text:
Gmail search operators:

Operator Example Description from: from:user@example.com Messages from sender to: to:me@example.com Messages to recipient subject: subject:meeting Subject contains after: after:2024/01/01 After date before: before:2024/12/31 Before date is: is:unread Message state has: has:attachment Has attachment category: category:promotions Gmail category

query := "from:boss@company.com is:unread"

// Messages with attachments this year

// In a specific category

// Combine multiple criteria
query := "from:notifications@github.com subject:PR after:2024/06/01"

result, err := service.SendSimple(ctx, "me", opts)

docs.title: Google Search Console
docs.text: The searchconsoleutil/v1 package reads Google Search Console: the properties a credential can see, search performance, sitemaps and URL inspection. It is read-only and requests only the webmasters.readonly scope.

docs.title: Connect with a service account
docs.text:
A service account lets a server read Search Console without a person signing in.

  1. In Google Cloud, enable the Google Search Console API and create a service account and a JSON key for it.
  2. In Search Console, open Settings, then Users and permissions, and add the service account's email as a user on each property it should read. The lowest permission that can read is enough.
  3. Create the client from the key:
import searchconsole "github.com/grokify/gogoogle/searchconsoleutil/v1"

key, err := os.ReadFile("key.json")
if err != nil {
    return err
}
email, _ := searchconsole.ServiceAccountEmail(key) // the address to add in step 2
c, err := searchconsole.NewFromServiceAccountKey(ctx, key)

The context is used each time the access token is refreshed, so pass one that lasts as long as the client. NewFromServiceAccountKey accepts only service account keys. To use credentials from another source, authorize an *http.Client for searchconsole.ScopeReadonly and pass it to searchconsole.New.

docs.title: Properties
docs.text:
sites, err := c.Sites(ctx)
for _, s := range sites {
    if s.CanRead() && s.MatchesDomain("example.com") {
        fmt.Println(s.URL, s.PermissionLevel, s.IsDomainProperty())
    }
}

A property is either a domain property, sc-domain:example.com, covering every subdomain and protocol, or a URL-prefix property such as https://www.example.com/. The URL is the identifier the other methods take. MatchesDomain is true when the property's host is the domain, a subdomain of it, or a parent domain that covers it.

docs.title: Search performance
docs.text:
end := time.Now().AddDate(0, 0, -3) // Search Console holds data back for days
start := end.AddDate(0, 0, -27)

totals, err := c.Totals(ctx, site, start, end)       // clicks, impressions, CTR, position
daily, err := c.Daily(ctx, site, start, end)         // one row per day, oldest first
queries, err := c.Top(ctx, site, searchconsole.DimensionQuery, start, end, 25)
pages, err := c.Top(ctx, site, searchconsole.DimensionPage, start, end, 25)

Query is the general form, with dimensions, filters, a search type, a data state and paging:

res, err := c.Query(ctx, site, searchconsole.Query{
    Start: start, End: end,
    Dimensions: []searchconsole.Dimension{searchconsole.DimensionQuery, searchconsole.DimensionDevice},
    Filters: []searchconsole.Filter{{
        Dimension: searchconsole.DimensionPage, Operator: searchconsole.FilterContains, Expression: "/blog/",
    }},
    RowLimit: 100,
})
fmt.Println(res.FirstIncompleteDate) // data from this date may still change

Only the calendar date of a time.Time is used. Search Console reports dates in Pacific time.

docs.title: Sitemaps and URL inspection
docs.text:
maps, err := c.Sitemaps(ctx, site)

in, err := c.InspectURL(ctx, site, "https://example.com/pricing")
fmt.Println(in.Indexed(), in.CoverageState, in.LastCrawl, in.GoogleCanonical)

URL inspection is limited per property per day, so cache what it returns.

docs.title: Errors
docs.text:
Failed API calls wrap both a sentinel and the underlying *googleapi.Error:

Error Meaning ErrUnauthorized Google rejected the credentials ErrForbidden The credentials cannot access the property, for example the service account was not added to it ErrNotFound The property, sitemap or URL does not exist for the credentials ErrQuotaExceeded A rate or daily quota was reached 
if errors.Is(err, searchconsole.ErrForbidden) {
    // ask the owner to add the service account to the property
}

docs.title: Google Sheets
docs.text: The sheetsutil package provides utilities for reading and writing Google Sheets data.

docs.title: Packages
docs.text: Package Description sheetsutil/v4 Cell value parsing and URL utilities sheetsutil/v4/sheetsmap Map sheet data to Go types with validation sheetsutil/iwark Low-level operations using Iwark library

docs.title: Cell Value Parsing
docs.text:
Parse Google Sheets API responses into typed Go structures:

import sheetsutil "github.com/grokify/gogoogle/sheetsutil/v4"

// Get values from Sheets API
vr, _ := service.Spreadsheets.Values.Get(spreadsheetID, "Sheet1!A1:D10").Do()

// Parse to typed grid - each cell has type information
grid := sheetsutil.ParseValueRange(vr)
for _, row := range grid {
    for _, cell := range row {
        fmt.Printf("Type: %s, Value: %s\n", cell.Type, cell.FormattedValue)
    }
}

// Or extract as simple strings
formatted := sheetsutil.ExtractFormattedValues(vr)  // Display values
raw := sheetsutil.ExtractRawValues(vr)               // Underlying values

docs.title: Cell Types
docs.text: Type Description CellTypeEmpty Empty cell CellTypeString Text value CellTypeNumber Numeric value CellTypeBool Boolean (TRUE/FALSE) CellTypeDate Date value CellTypeTime Time value CellTypeDateTime Date and time CellTypeDuration Duration CellTypeError Error value

docs.title: URL Utilities
docs.text:
Parse spreadsheet IDs from URLs and build URLs:

import sheetsutil "github.com/grokify/gogoogle/sheetsutil/v4"

// Extract spreadsheet ID from URL or plain ID
id, err := sheetsutil.ParseSpreadsheetURL(
    "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc123/edit#gid=0",
)
// id = "abc123"

// Extract full info including sheet GID and range
info, err := sheetsutil.ParseSpreadsheetURLFull(
    "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc123/edit#gid=456&range=A1:D10",
)
// info.SpreadsheetID = "abc123"
// info.SheetGID = 456
// info.Range = "A1:D10"

// Build URLs from ID
url := sheetsutil.BuildSpreadsheetURL("abc123")
// "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc123/edit"

url := sheetsutil.BuildSpreadsheetURLWithSheet("abc123", 456)
// "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc123/edit#gid=456"

// Check if string is a Sheets URL
if sheetsutil.IsSpreadsheetURL(input) {
    // Handle URL
}

docs.title: Speech-to-Text
docs.text: The speechtotext package provides a wrapper for Google's Speech-to-Text API.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Transcribe audio from bytes or files
  • Multiple language support
  • Confidence threshold filtering
  • Word-level timestamps

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
import (
    "context"
    "os"
    "github.com/grokify/gogoogle/speechtotext"
)

// Read audio file
audioData, _ := os.ReadFile("audio.wav")

// Transcribe
result, err := speechtotext.Transcribe(ctx, httpClient, speechtotext.TranscribeRequest{
    Audio:        audioData,
    LanguageCode: "en-US",
    Encoding:     "LINEAR16",
    SampleRate:   16000,
})
if err != nil {
    log.Fatal(err)
}

fmt.Println(result.Transcript)

docs.title: TranscribeRequest
docs.text: Field Type Description Audio []byte Audio data LanguageCode string BCP-47 language code Encoding string Audio encoding SampleRate int Sample rate in Hz MinConfidence float64 Minimum confidence (0-1)

docs.title: Audio Encodings
docs.text: Encoding Description LINEAR16 Uncompressed 16-bit PCM FLAC FLAC encoded MULAW μ-law encoded AMR AMR (Adaptive Multi-Rate) AMR_WB AMR Wideband OGG_OPUS Ogg Opus MP3 MP3 encoded

docs.text:

Language Code English (US) en-US English (UK) en-GB Spanish es-ES French fr-FR German de-DE Japanese ja-JP Chinese (Mandarin) zh-CN Portuguese (Brazil) pt-BR

docs.title: Transcription Result
docs.text:
type TranscribeResult struct {
    Transcript  string    // Full transcript
    Confidence  float64   // Overall confidence (0-1)
    Words       []Word    // Word-level results
}

type Word struct {
    Word       string
    StartTime  time.Duration
    EndTime    time.Duration
    Confidence float64
}

docs.title: Confidence Filtering
docs.text:
result, err := speechtotext.Transcribe(ctx, httpClient, speechtotext.TranscribeRequest{
    Audio:         audioData,
    LanguageCode:  "en-US",
    MinConfidence: 0.8, // Only include high-confidence results
})

    LanguageCode: "en-US",

docs.title: Long Audio
docs.text:
For audio longer than 1 minute, use async recognition:

operation, err := speechtotext.TranscribeAsync(ctx, httpClient, speechtotext.AsyncTranscribeRequest{
    AudioURI:     "gs://bucket/audio.wav", // GCS URI
    LanguageCode: "en-US",
})

// Poll for completion

docs.text:
1. Go to Google Cloud Console

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
1. Use appropriate encoding - LINEAR16 for highest accuracy
  2. Set correct sample rate - Must match audio
  3. Specify language - Don't rely on auto-detection
  4. Use GCS for long audio - Required for files > 1 minute

docs.title: Error Handling
docs.text:
result, err := speechtotext.Transcribe(ctx, httpClient, request)
if err != nil {
    switch {
    case strings.Contains(err.Error(), "INVALID_ARGUMENT"):
        log.Println("Invalid audio format or parameters")
    case strings.Contains(err.Error(), "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"):
        log.Println("Quota exceeded")
    default:
        log.Printf("Transcription error: %v", err)
    }
}

docs.title: Text-to-Speech
docs.text: The texttospeech/v1beta1 package provides a wrapper for Google's Text-to-Speech API.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Synthesize speech from text
  • Multiple voice options (WaveNet, Standard)
  • Multiple audio formats
  • SSML support

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
import (
    "context"
    "os"
    "github.com/grokify/gogoogle/texttospeech/v1beta1"
)

// Synthesize speech
audio, err := texttospeech.Synthesize(ctx, httpClient, texttospeech.SynthesizeRequest{
    Text:         "Hello, world!",
    LanguageCode: "en-US",
    VoiceName:    "en-US-Wavenet-D",
    AudioFormat:  "MP3",
})
if err != nil {
    log.Fatal(err)
}

// Save to file
err = os.WriteFile("output.mp3", audio, 0644)

docs.title: Search Console client

import searchconsole "github.com/grokify/gogoogle/searchconsoleutil/v1"

c, err := searchconsole.NewFromServiceAccountKey(ctx, key)
sites, err := c.Sites(ctx)
totals, err := c.Totals(ctx, site, start, end)
  • Properties. Sites lists the properties a credential can see and tells domain properties from URL-prefix ones. MatchesDomain finds the properties that cover a domain.
  • Search performance. Totals, Daily and Top cover the common readings. Query is the general form, with dimensions, filters, search type, data state and paging. Results report the date from which data may still change.
  • Indexing. Sitemaps lists a property's sitemaps. InspectURL returns how Google indexed one page, and Indexed() answers the common question.
  • Credentials. NewFromServiceAccountKey accepts only service account keys and requests only webmasters.readonly. ServiceAccountEmail returns the address to add as a user on each property. New takes any authorized *http.Client.
  • Errors. Failed calls wrap a sentinel (ErrUnauthorized, ErrForbidden, ErrNotFound, ErrQuotaExceeded) and the underlying Google error, so both errors.Is and errors.As work.
